create.name: Maryam Hasnaa
create.bio:
Maryam Hasnaa grew up in a family where both parents taught spirituality, so ceremony and mystical practice were part of her childhood. She went on to train as an energy worker and flower-essence practitioner and was initiated as a priestess, and she now describes herself as an intuitive and a channel. Her teaching is aimed above all at highly sensitive people: those who take in more sensory and emotional detail than most and can find it overwhelming. She treats that sensitivity as a capacity to be trained, with practices for energetic boundaries, clearing, grounding and steadying the nervous system, alongside material on the Akashic records, ancestors, timelines and working with nature.

She founded New Earth Mystery School, an online community that meets for live classes on Zoom each month with guest teachers and a team of senior students, and Resonance Apothecary, which makes flower essences and ritual products from its own garden. She also runs weekend online immersions, one-to-one sessions and a mentorship programme, and leads small Etheric Gardening journeys to places such as Mount Shasta, Joshua Tree and Morocco. Her manner is gentle and unhurried, and she often appears as a guest on podcasts about sensitivity and relationships. At Kripalu she teaches a weekend retreat for highly sensitive people.

courses.title: Unlock Your Superpower: A Retreat for Highly Sensitive People
courses.description: A residential weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, for people who feel and perceive things intensely. Maryam guides participants in mapping their own sensitivities and strengths, setting boundaries without closing off empathy, and linking sensitivity to a sense of purpose.

courses.title: Co-weaving Timelines
courses.description: A live weekend immersion on Zoom about time, ancestry and parallel possibilities. Participants call on the support of ancestors and of future generations through guided energy work, with recordings available for a year afterwards.

courses.title: Make Me an Instrument Course
courses.description: A recorded weekend course on telling apart the voices people often lump together as intuition, guides, ancestors or the higher self. It works on becoming a clearer channel for creativity and guidance, and comes with a year of access to the playbacks.

courses.title: The Subtle Art of Relationship Dynamics
courses.description: An online weekend immersion, now offered as recordings, on the energy exchanged between people in close relationships. It draws on patterns from nature to explore more cooperative ways of relating while keeping a clear sense of self.

courses.title: Growing Our Reach
courses.description: A two-day intensive, available as recordings, on staying centred while spending time online. It covers energetic hygiene, boundaries and ways to clear what gets picked up from screens and social media.

courses.title: New Earth Mystery School Membership
courses.description: Maryam's online school for sensitive and intuitive people. Members join two live Zoom classes a month on themes such as energetic boundaries and self-regulation, plus community calls, a qigong class and a library of past recordings; a lighter tier covers the live classes only.
courses.price: $44 USD per month or $444 USD per year (Planting Seeds tier $22 USD per month)

courses.title: One-on-One Sessions and Three-Month Mentorship
courses.description: Private online sessions with Maryam combining energy work, flower essences and intuitive guidance, with practices to carry on afterwards. Single sessions run 45 or 75 minutes, and a three-month mentorship offers weekly meetings for deeper work.

courses.title: Etheric Gardening Retreat: Mount Shasta
courses.description: A small group journey to sites in and around Mount Shasta in northern California, a mountain many traditions treat as sacred. The days combine time on the land with ceremony and energy practice; an application is required.

free_resources.title: 2027 Energy Forecast (free playback)
free_resources.description: A recorded talk in which Maryam shares the themes she senses for the coming year, which also shape the school's curriculum. Access is free with an email address.

free_resources.title: Clearing Your Akashic Record (free guided meditation)
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guided meditation from Maryam's meditation library, working with the Akashic records. The same page sells her other recorded meditations.
